problems.summary: Differentiate $g(x)=e^{x}(3x^{2}-6x+6)$: choose the correct setup, then simplify.
problems.fullText:
Find and simplify the derivative of the following function.

$$g(x)=e^{x}\left(3x^{2}-6x+6\right)$$

a. Which of the following shows how to find the derivative of $g(x)$?

A. $g'(x)=\dfrac{(3x^{2}-6x+6)\,\frac{d}{dx}(3x^{2}-6x+6)+e^{x}\,\frac{d}{dx}(e^{x})}{(3x^{2}-6x+6)^{2}}$

B. $g'(x)=\dfrac{(3x^{2}-6x+6)\,\frac{d}{dx}(e^{x})+e^{x}\,\frac{d}{dx}(3x^{2}-6x+6)}{(e^{x})^{2}}$

C. $g'(x)=e^{x}\,\frac{d}{dx}(e^{x})+(3x^{2}-6x+6)\,\frac{d}{dx}(3x^{2}-6x+6)$

D. $g'(x)=\frac{d}{dx}(e^{x})\,(3x^{2}-6x+6)+e^{x}\,\frac{d}{dx}(3x^{2}-6x+6)$

b. Find the derivative of $g(x)$.

B. $u=g(x)=2x$ and $y=f(u)=u^{8}$

C. $u=g(x)=x^{8}$ and $y=f(u)=2u+9$

D. $u=g(x)=2x+9$ and $y=f(u)=u$

b. Find $\dfrac{dy}{dx}$.
